provenance: Project-authored synthetic English greeting and small-talk seed examples. Not a public conversational benchmark or human preference dataset.

intents.name: greeting
answers: Hello! It is nice to meet you. How is your day going?
Hi! We can have a little chat. How are you today?

intents.name: morning
train: A very good morning to you.
Hi, I just started my day.
dev: I am saying hello at the start of the day.
test: The sun is up. Good morning to you!
answers: Good morning! I hope your day starts well.
Morning! Do you have something nice planned for today?

intents.name: evening
train: Hi, my day is nearly over.
test: Hello, it is the end of the day here.
answers: Good evening! How was your day?
Hello! I hope you have a pleasant evening.

intents.name: wellbeing
train: Is everything going well with you?
dev: How is everything with you today?
test: I hope you are well. How are things?
answers: I am here and ready to chat. How are you doing?
Thanks for asking! I am ready to help with a short chat or a story.

intents.name: thanks
dev: I am grateful for your help.
test: You helped me out. Thank you so much!
answers: You are welcome! I am glad I could help.
You are very welcome. Is there anything else you would like to talk about?

intents.name: farewell
dev: Let us talk again some other time.
test: I need to leave, so I will say goodbye.
answers: Goodbye! Have a lovely day.
See you later! Thanks for the chat.

intents.name: name
dev: How would you introduce yourself to me?
test: I do not know what to call you yet.
answers: You can call me StoryLab. I am a small language model for stories and simple English conversation.
I am StoryLab, a small story language model. It is nice to meet you.

intents.name: capabilities
train: Tell me what you can help with.
What are you able to do?
Can you tell me your abilities?
What kind of things can we do here?

answers: I can try simple English conversation and short stories. My answers are limited, and I can make mistakes.
We can practice greetings or talk about a short story. I am a small model, so I may not understand every question.

dev: There is something I would like help with.
test: I am looking for a bit of help, please.
answers: I can try. What would you like help with?
Tell me what you need, and I will try a simple answer.

intents.name: clarification
train: Could you say that more simply?

dev: That explanation was not clear to me.
test: I am having trouble understanding your answer.
answers: Which part is confusing? I can try to say it more simply.
Of course. Tell me which part you would like me to explain.

test: I am smiling because my day went well.
answers: That is lovely to hear! What made your day special?

answers: A little bird found a lost hat in a tree. It brought the hat home, and its friend was very happy.

intents.name: limits
